minister_statement: At first reading the Minister stated the Government intends to bring the Act into force 'as soon as practicable after passage, given the escalating scale of scam losses'.
commencement_note: Ministerial language ('as soon as practicable', urgency framing) implies commencement within months of passage.
relevance: Banks and payment-service clients may face new countermeasure and restitution duties.

minister_statement: The Second Minister for Law indicated at a doorstop that collective-sale reforms would 'take effect from the 2027 en-bloc cycle', suggesting a runway of about a year.
commencement_note: Signal points to commencement roughly one year out (2027 en-bloc cycle).
relevance: Clients holding strata-titled commercial property; collective sale committee advisory work.

minister_statement: In the 15 Jul 2026 sitting the Minister said the Government 'will study extending the grievance-handling framework to smaller employers within the next two years'.
commencement_note: Exploratory language ('will study', 'within the next two years') — no bill introduced yet; monitor only.
relevance: Employment clients below the current 25-employee threshold.
